Stadin fakt Nymbot de keri betwin chat: wetin fɔ kɔl yu, wetin yu de wok ɔn, ɛn aw yu want am fɔ de rait ansɛ. Dɛn de kɛp wan ɛntri ɛtim wan so mek yu ɛn fɔ rɛd di lɪst, kɔrɛkt di lɪn we nɔ rɛt, ɛn tɔ-aw di wan we yu nɔ rili want sɛv — wan rɔlɪŋ sɔmri nɔ de ɛf yu de kɔntɛst am. Fakt we yu mɛnʃɔn we yu de pass de nɔtɪs ɛn dɛn de ɔlweis sɛd ɔklɔ, wit wan tɛp fɔ tek dɛm bɛk; tɔn di nɔtɪs ɔf ɛn ?rimɛmbɛ stil wok.
